verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official CLI, and a concrete CLI command (`stripe sandbox create`) provisions a sandbox with working API keys without registration, which suits agent workflows. However, nothing shows the CLI exposing the crypto and stablecoin features (stablecoin payments, payouts, onramp, financial accounts), and its AI-native depth is only implied. missing for 10: evidence of CLI commands covering crypto/stablecoin resources, in-depth CLI docs describing AI-native or agent workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use for this product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: run the command `stripe sandbox create --help` to provision an anonymous Stripe sandbox with working API keys. No account registration required.
